comparison.objective: Align both headrest posts with seat sleeves, depress a release button, insert to the lowest notch, and release locked.
comparison.physical_skill: Two-post insertion while one hand operates a sprung pawl release, not screw adjustment with a counterheld jam nut.
comparison.success_condition: Both posts seated at the lowest notch, pawl engaged, headrest still, and grippers clear; all four category/spec versions were read.
comparison.reason: Although both end in a retained mechanism state, the tested ability is button-gated dual insertion and latching rather than calibrated setting preservation and cycle verification.
